test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.

I didn’t sleep well last night because the dog is barking.

options.text: I didn’t __sleep well__ last night because the dog is barking.
I didn’t sleep well __last night because__ the dog is barking.
I didn’t sleep well last night because __the dog is barking.__
__I didn’t__ sleep well last night because the dog is barking.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'I didn’t sleep well last night because __the dog is barking'.__**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the error lies in** 'I didn’t sleep well last night because the dog is barking'.__**
 
• Here, the error is in **'Past Tense'.**
 
• According to the rule of it, when the sentence is in Past Tense and It shows progression of incidents, then the other part of the sentence should be in Past Continuous Tense.
 
• So, replacing **'is barking'** with **'was barking'** will make the sentence correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'I didn’t sleep well__**** last night because the dog is barking'** has no error in the underlined portion of the sentence.
 
• **'I didn’t sleep well __last night because__**** the dog is barking'** has no error in the underlined portion of the sentence.
 
• **__'I didn’t__**** sleep well last night because the dog is barking'** has no error in the underlined portion of the sentence.
